import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 998244353;
    static long[] pw10 = new long[17];

    static String to_string(BigInteger x) {
        if (x.equals(BigInteger.ZERO)) return "0";
        StringBuilder s = new StringBuilder();
        boolean neg = x.signum() < 0;
        if (neg) x = x.negate();
        while (x.compareTo(BigInteger.ZERO) > 0) {
            s.append(x.mod(BigInteger.TEN).intValue());
            x = x.divide(BigInteger.TEN);
        }
        if (neg) s.append('-');
        return s.reverse().toString();
    }

    static void solve(List<Integer> vars, int base, BigInteger[] ans) {
        int n = vars.size();
        List<Integer> left = new ArrayList<>();
        List<Integer> right = new ArrayList<>();
        
        dfs(0, 0, vars, base, left, n);
        
        dfs2(n / 2, 0, vars, right, n);
        
        Collections.sort(left);
        Collections.sort(right);
        
        long sumR = 0;
        for (int val : right) {
            sumR = (sumR + val) % MOD;
        }
        int j = right.size() - 1;
        
        for (int a : left) {
            while (j >= 0 && (long)a + right.get(j) >= MOD) --j;
            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf((long)a * right.size()));
            ans[0] = ans[0].add(BigInteger.valueOf(sumR));
            ans[0] = ans[0].subtract(BigInteger.valueOf((long)(right.size() - 1 - j) * MOD));
        }
    }

    static void dfs(int idx, int cur, List<Integer> vars, int base, List<Integer> left, int n) {
        if (idx == n / 2) {
            left.add((cur + base) % MOD);
            return;
        }
        dfs(idx + 1, cur, vars, base, left, n);
        dfs(idx + 1, (cur + vars.get(idx)) % MOD, vars, base, left, n);
    }

    static void dfs2(int idx, int cur, List<Integer> vars, List<Integer> right, int n) {
        if (idx == n) {
            right.add(cur);
            return;
        }
        dfs2(idx + 1, cur, vars, right, n);
        dfs2(idx + 1, (cur + vars.get(idx)) % MOD, vars, right, n);
    }

    static long count_prefix(String s, long n, String ns) {
        long val = 0;
        for (char c : s.toCharArray()) val = val * 10 + (c - '0');
        
        long cnt = 0;
        int slen = s.length();
        int nlen = ns.length();
        
        for (int len = slen; len <= nlen; ++len) {
            if (len < nlen) {
                cnt += pw10[len - slen];
            } else {
                if (s.compareTo(ns) < 0) {
                    cnt += pw10[len - slen];
                } else if (s.equals(ns)) {
                    cnt += n - val * pw10[nlen - slen] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return cnt;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out);
        
        long n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        
        String ns;
        if (n == 0) ns = "0";
        else {
            StringBuilder t = new StringBuilder();
            long tmp = n;
            while (tmp > 0) {
                t.append((char)('0' + (tmp % 10)));
                tmp /= 10;
            }
            ns = t.reverse().toString();
        }
        
        pw10[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 17; ++i) pw10[i] = pw10[i-1] * 10;
        
        BigInteger total = BigInteger.ZERO;
        
        for (int len = 1; len <= ns.length(); ++len) {
            for (int first_diff = 0; first_diff < Math.min(len, ns.length()); ++first_diff) {
                String prefix = "";
                long cur_val = 0;
                
                for (int i = 0; i < first_diff; ++i) {
                    prefix += ns.charAt(i);
                    cur_val = cur_val * 10 + (ns.charAt(i) - '0');
                }
                
                for (int last = 0; last <= 9; ++last) {
                    if (first_diff == 0 && last == 0) continue;
                    if (first_diff < ns.length() && last == ns.charAt(first_diff) - '0') continue;
                    if (len == ns.length() && last > ns.charAt(first_diff) - '0') continue;
                    
                    String curp = prefix + (char)('0' + last);
                    long curv = cur_val * 10 + last;
                    
                    long base = 0;
                    String tmp = "";
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < curp.length(); ++i) {
                        char start = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                        for (char d = start; d < curp.charAt(i); ++d) {
                            base += count_prefix(tmp + d, n, ns);
                        }
                        tmp += curp.charAt(i);
                    }
                    base += curp.length() - 1;
                    
                    List<Integer> vars = new ArrayList<>();
                    tmp = curp;
                    for (int i = curp.length(); i < len; ++i) {
                        int cnt = (int)(count_prefix(tmp + '0', n, ns) % MOD);
                        vars.add(cnt);
                        tmp += '0';
                    }
                    
                    base += 1;
                    base -= curv * pw10[len - curp.length()];
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < vars.size(); ++i) {
                        int idx = vars.size() - 1 - i;
                        vars.set(idx, (vars.get(idx) - (int)(pw10[i] % MOD) % MOD + MOD) % MOD);
                    }
                    
                    int b = (int)(base % MOD);
                    if (b < 0) b += MOD;
                    
                    for (int i = 0; i < vars.size(); ++i) {
                        int v = vars.get(i) % MOD;
                        if (v < 0) v += MOD;
                        vars.set(i, v);
                    }
                    
                    BigInteger[] ans = new BigInteger[1];
                    ans[0] = total;
                    solve(vars, b, ans);
                    total = ans[0];
                }
            }
        }
        
        // Handle numbers that are prefixes of n
        String cur = "";
        long val = 0;
        for (int len = 1; len <= ns.length(); ++len) {
            cur += ns.charAt(len-1);
            val = val * 10 + (ns.charAt(len-1) - '0');
            
            long cnt = 1;
            String tmp = "";
            for (int i = 0; i < cur.length(); ++i) {
                char start = (i == 0) ? '1' : '0';
                for (char d = start; d < cur.charAt(i); ++d) {
                    cnt += count_prefix(tmp + d, n, ns);
                }
                tmp += cur.charAt(i);
            }
            cnt += cur.length() - 1;
            cnt -= val;
            cnt %= MOD;
            if (cnt < 0) cnt += MOD;
            
            total = total.add(BigInteger.valueOf(cnt));
        }
        
        total = total.mod(BigInteger.valueOf(1000000007L));
        pw.println(to_string(total));
        pw.close();
    }
}
